name: Twinfield AI Connect, by iWebDevelopment
description:
Twinfield AI Connect connects Claude directly to your Twinfield administration. Ask questions in plain language and get instant answers from your live accounting data, from a quick check on outstanding invoices to a full accounts receivable analysis. The connector is built and operated by iWebDevelopment, an official Twinfield partner specializing in accounting integrations.

What you can do:
- Financials: query outstanding invoices, revenue per customer, cost comparisons across periods, and prepare draft journal entries for your approval
- Receivables & payables: review overdue invoices, run aging analyses, identify payment risks, and prepare payment reminders
- Customers & suppliers: find contact details, detect missing data, and create or update debtors and creditors
- Bookkeeping: look up ledger transactions, check VAT positions, and review bookings per journal or period
- Analytics: cash flow projections, gross margin insights, cost trends year over year, DSO/DPO and working capital analysis

Every write action is prepared as a draft and requires your explicit confirmation before anything is executed in Twinfield. Nothing changes in your administration without your approval.

Setup takes about two minutes: add the server URL to Claude, log in with your own Twinfield account via the secure authorization flow, and ask your first question. No plug-ins or installations in Twinfield required. Your data stays in Twinfield and the platform is ISO 27001 certified and independently pentested. You choose which administrations to connect and can revoke authorization at any time.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Twinfield AI Connect, by iWebDevelopment to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Twinfield AI Connect, by iWebDevelopment to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp-twinfield.iwebdevelopment.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Twinfield AI Connect, by iWebDevelopment MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Twinfield AI Connect, by iWebDevelopment lists 14 MCP tools, including analyze_data, read_operation, get_assistant_guidelines, get_entity_schema, get_provider_capabilities, get_scope_endpoints, get_started, list_administrations, list_available_tables, list_scopes, search_endpoints, and select_administration.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Twinfield AI Connect, by iWebDevelopment?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Twinfield AI Connect, by iWebDevelopment in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Twinfield AI Connect, by iWebDevelopment MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Twinfield AI Connect, by iWebDevelopment requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Twinfield AI Connect, by iWebDevelopment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Twinfield AI Connect, by iWebDevelopment is developed by iWebDevelopment. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
